reason: Fixed. Every numeric value in a visual is checked whatever its size. `validate_numbers` keeps its significance rule for answer text; visuals call it with a flag that checks every number, so a chart of small invented integers reports them as unverified.

Fixed by refusal: transforms and encodings that compute new values are refused (`calculate`, `aggregate`, `joinaggregate`, `window`, `bin`, `density`, `regression`, `loess`, and encoding-level `aggregate` and `bin`). Allowed are `filter` and `fold`, and `params` only in filter predicates, selections and conditional encodings. Every value the reader sees is then a raw datum that was checked.

Fixed. Validation walks the whole spec recursively, including `layer`, `concat`/`hconcat`/`vconcat`, `facet`, `repeat` and `spec`. At any depth it refuses a `url` key, an `href` channel, the `image` mark, `datasets` and `usermeta`, and applies the transform rules of I-002.

Fixed by changing the input. The model no longer writes Mermaid source: `nexus-diagram` is JSON (`{type: flowchart|state, nodes, edges}` or `{type: sequence, participants, messages}`), checked by shape like `nexus-graph`. The client builds Mermaid text from it, escaping every label, so `click`, `href`, `call`, links, init directives, markdown-string and HTML labels cannot be written at all. Node count is the length of `nodes`. No Mermaid parser is needed.

Fixed. Each checked value in `checks` carries `found_in` and, when it is `evidence`, the matched snippet's `doc_type` and `provenance_tier`, so a value from a code constant or from machine-read text is shown with the same marker the text answer uses and is not presented as document text.
Fixed: the A2A change is dropped. ADR-0004 §5 keeps A2A minimal until a real consumer pulls it.

Correct, and acknowledged in the SPEC. For chart data a value match alone is weaker than for text. A chart datum is marked `grounded` only if its value and its category label occur in the same evidence snippet; a value found elsewhere is `found_elsewhere`, counted and shown as not verified. The footer says 'found in the evidence', not 'verified', and §4.3 states the remaining limit (same snippet is not same row).

Fixed. Order: fences are removed first; the existing text checks run on the answer without fences, so their meaning is unchanged (today's answers have no fences); visual checks run on the fence contents separately. The text citation extractor never sees `cite` fields.

Fixed. A visual is collapsed behind a warning when it has at least one checkable item (number or cite) and none of them is grounded or verified. A visual with no checkable item is shown with the footer 'nothing in this visual could be checked'.

Fixed. The top-level allowlist is listed in §4.2. The Vega-Lite runtime and its JSON schema are vendored from the same 5.x release, the exact version recorded beside the files like the existing vendored libraries, and a test asserts that the schema file and the runtime report the same version.
Fixed. The header is set only on `/` and `/static`, so `/docs` and `/redoc` are untouched; tests assert that, and that the existing graph view and inline chat graph render under the policy.

Fixed. The first implementation step is a feasibility check that names the files: a browser-global build for each library, or loading it from `app.js`, which is already a module. If neither works without a build step for a library, the SPEC goes back to review rather than adding a build step.

Fixed. The client matches a fence start on the accumulated text at a line start, not per chunk. A fence still open at `done` is dropped as 'incomplete visual'; an `error` event before `done` removes the placeholder.

Fixed. Bar and line switch only when x is nominal, ordinal or temporal and y is quantitative, with at most a `color` series; table is always available; otherwise the switch is hidden. §7 tests each rule.

Fixed. The hand run uses three fixed questions written into the run record before the run, each run three times. Pass: the comparison question yields a chart with every value grounded in at least two of three runs; the process question yields a diagram in at least two of three; the question whose evidence lacks values yields no visual in three of three.
Fixed. First use records, in the improvement-loop hand run's record, the number of answers with a visual and how many of them had any value not found in the evidence.
Fixed. Defined: every response key except `prompt_version`, `visuals` and `visuals_dropped` is byte-identical to today for an answer with no fence.
Fixed. One helper defines the whole header for both SPECs, and both SPECs state the same full policy; whichever lands first adds the helper, and one test asserts the exact header string.
